zh.title: 大气数据加载与诊断优化
zh.summary: AOD 与补充能见度独立加载和重试，保留可用天气数据，并完善光污染取消处理与错误诊断。

items.text: 改善桌面标题返回按钮与云层功能菜单的键盘可访问性，并保留横向表格的键盘滚动入口。
修复光污染数据加载被取消后仍可能继续下载或返回结果的问题。
AOD 与补充能见度分别加载和重试，一项失败时保留另一项数据；收藏对比明确标出单项加载失败。
AOD 加载失败时，仍可查看已有的天气观测证据。
完善天气、大气、光污染与更新检查的错误诊断，便于反馈与排查加载问题。

en.title: Atmosphere loading and diagnostics
en.summary: Independent loading and retry for AOD and supplementary visibility, preserving available weather data, with improved light pollution cancellation and error diagnostics.

items.text: Improved keyboard accessibility of the desktop title back button and cloud function menu while retaining keyboard scrolling for horizontal tables.
Fixed cancelled light pollution requests continuing to download or return results.
AOD and supplementary visibility load and retry independently, retaining available data when either fails. Favorite comparisons identify individual loading failures.
Available weather evidence remains visible when AOD fails to load.
Improved error diagnostics for weather, atmosphere, light pollution and update checks to help report and investigate loading problems.
